URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/trump-says-us-to-end-4-billion-in-annual-military-aid-to-israel-by-end-of-2026/
(Times of Israel, 3 Nov 2026 — WebFetch extraction)
President Donald Trump declared on Tuesday that the United States will cease providing approximately $4 billion in annual military assistance to Israel after this year concludes. Trump stated: "we give Israel $4 billion a year — we made a deal months ago that we're stopping" and "by the end of this year, we won't be paying Israel."
"They've become a very successful country. They don't need it." He also claimed Netanyahu initiated the discussion, saying the Israeli leader believed ceasing aid "would be appropriate."
The current 10-year memorandum of understanding provides Israel $3.8 billion annually and does not expire until the end of 2027 [liveblog: through September 2028].
Finance Ministry officials stated they "were surprised by the intention to do so immediately," according to Walla news. One senior defense official told Kan: "We did not expect this announcement, certainly not today."
Netanyahu's office offered no immediate comment.
Gadi Eisenkot, chairman of the Yashar opposition party: "He can no longer be trusted and must be replaced."
